stemMd: A triangle of area 45 has base 15. What is its height?
explanationMd: The area is half base times height. Thus height is $2(45)/15=6$.

distractorRationale.c: Subtracts the base from an unrelated quantity.
distractorRationale.d: Divides area by half the wrong dimension.
distractorRationale.a: Forgets the one-half in the area formula.
